text:
aya: Follow-up from today's authz incident - root cause appears to be a missed step in service-token rotation + an intermittent drop in audit ingestion. Need clear owners and short deadlines.
aya: High-level plan:
- detection & alerting for rotation failures
- ensure audit event coverage + backfill where missing
- automate rotation runbooks and tighten perms
- add recurring token-health metric to ops dashboard

aya: Proposed action items (owners + target date):
- tom -> rotation-failure checker + prometheus alert (due 2026-04-07)
- chris -> audit pipeline stabilisation + backfill query (due 2026-04-04)
- security-eng -> runbook + SLO/alert thresholds (due 2026-04-06)

tom: I'll take the rotation-checker. Plan: exporter -> metric -> alert. PR by EOD Friday.

tom: tentative alert rule I'll wire up:
```
# prom alert: token rotation failures
expr: increase(service_token_rotation_failures[5m]) > 0
for: 1m
labels:
  severity: page
```

chris: Audit pipeline shows occasional bulk-retries that drop events. I'll add dedupe + increase retention for auth logs to 90d and craft a backfill ES query. Need security-eng to vet fields.

security-eng: We'll draft the backfill query and a Kibana saved search for SOC ingestion. Also drafting a blameless runbook that includes rollback and verification steps.

ops-bot: Reminder: remediation sync scheduled Thu 10:00 PT. Auto-reminder will post 24h before.

aya: I'll create tracker tasks and tag owners. Tagging required for closing the loop.

chris: Created issue https://redwood-internal/issue/2002 with sample events and links to broken spans.

aya: Note on pattern: this is the third token-related incident in ~8 months. Recommend weekly token-health check in dashboard and an SLO: token-validation success >= 99.9%.

security-eng: Agreed on SLO. We'll propose exact thresholds and escalation policy in the runbook draft.

tom: PR opened for exporter and alert: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/812 - PTAL.

chris: PR opened for ES pipeline fixes: https://github.com/redwood/logs/pull/221 - includes dedupe & retention changes.

aya: Owners: when you close your item, post a quick status update in this thread so we can mark the postmortem as remediated. If any ETA slips, call it out early. Thanks all! :wave:
